<!doctype html>
<html lang="he" dir="rtl">
<head>
  <meta charset="UTF-8" />
  <meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1.0" />
  <meta name="theme-color" content="#30483f" />
  <meta name="description" content="האלבום המשפחתי של סבתא שולי — אנשים, רגעים ומשפטים שנשארים בלב." />
  <title>הסיפור של סבתא שולי | אלבום משפחתי</title>
  <style>
    :root { --cream:#f8f5ec; --paper:#fffdf6; --ink:#26352e; --green:#30483f; --deep:#1d3028; --gold:#bd8e51; --ochre:#d8b77e; --muted:#738177; --border:#e4ded0; --rose:#a65c54; --shadow:0 16px 44px rgba(39,47,34,.075); }
    * {box-sizing:border-box} html{scroll-behavior:smooth} body{margin:0;background:var(--cream);color:var(--ink);font-family:Arial,'Noto Sans Hebrew',sans-serif;line-height:1.65} button,input,textarea,select{font:inherit} button{cursor:pointer} a{color:inherit} .shell{max-width:1220px;margin:auto;padding:0 25px}
    header{position:sticky;top:0;z-index:20;background:rgba(248,245,236,.94);backdrop-filter:blur(18px);border-bottom:1px solid #e5dfd2}.topbar{height:79px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:15px}.brand{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px;font-weight:800;color:var(--deep);text-decoration:none;white-space:nowrap}.brand-mark{width:41px;height:41px;display:grid;place-items:center;border:1px solid #c3a071;border-radius:50%;font-family:Georgia,serif;font-size:28px;color:var(--gold);background:#fffaf0}.brand-name{font-size:20px}.brand-sub{display:block;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:500;color:var(--muted)}.header-actions{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px}.textbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:var(--green);font-weight:700;padding:9px}.textbtn:hover{text-decoration:underline}.menu-button{display:none}
    .hero{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--green);color:#faf7ee;border-bottom-left-radius:35px;border-bottom-right-radius:35px}.hero::before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:radial-gradient(circle at 81% 17%,rgba(215,185,127,.16),transparent 29%),radial-gradient(circle at 22% 92%,rgba(177,195,171,.13),transparent 35%)}.hero-inner{position:relative;min-height:470px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:55px;padding-top:65px;padding-bottom:65px}.hero-copy{flex:1}.eyebrow{font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.17em;font-weight:bold;color:#ecd4a9;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px}.eyebrow:before{content:'';width:36px;height:1px;background:#ecd4a9}.hero h1{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;font-size:clamp(41px,5vw,70px);line-height:1.15;font-weight:500;margin:25px 0 19px;letter-spacing:-.035em}.hero h1 em{font-style:normal;color:#e5c69a}.hero p{max-width:570px;font-size:19px;color:#e2e7db;line-height:1.9}.hero-cta{margin-top:25px;display:flex;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.btn{border:1px solid transparent;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 19px;display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-weight:700;transition:transform .18s,background .18s;text-decoration:none}.btn:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}.btn.primary{background:#d9b77d;color:#24372e}.btn.ghost{border-color:#a4b1a2;background:transparent;color:white}.btn.dark{background:var(--green);color:white}.btn.outline{background:transparent;border-color:var(--border);color:var(--green)}.btn.danger{background:#a14441;color:white}.hero-art{width:340px;height:330px;position:relative;flex-shrink:0}.paper{position:absolute;width:225px;height:285px;padding:12px 12px 43px;background:#fdf8ec;box-shadow:0 18px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.23)}.paper:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:14px;left:0;right:0;text-align:center;height:8px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,transparent 26%,#dcc9ad 26%,#dcc9ad 74%,transparent 74%);opacity:.55}.paper.back{transform:rotate(-12deg);right:83px;top:15px}.paper.front{transform:rotate(9deg);right:28px;top:28px}.paper-image{width:100%;height:100%;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#9a9f82,#b7aa89 60%,#ccb691);position:relative;overflow:hidden}.paper-image:before{content:'';position:absolute;width:170px;height:170px;background:rgba(241,224,185,.35);border-radius:50%;top:30px;left:15px}.paper-image:after{content:'';position:absolute;bottom:-35px;right:-20px;width:190px;height:155px;border-radius:55% 45% 0 0;background:rgba(66,95,73,.7)}.paper.back .paper-image{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#a78073,#c99c87,#edd6b2)}.sprig{position:absolute;top:236px;left:2px;font-size:82px;transform:rotate(-20deg);opacity:.75;filter:sepia(.3)}
    .intro{margin:60px auto 26px;display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:20px}.kicker{color:#9f754a;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:.12em;font-size:12px}.intro h2{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;font-size:36px;font-weight:500;margin:5px 0}.intro p{color:var(--muted);margin:0}.stats{font-size:14px;color:#879088;white-space:nowrap}.sections{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px;margin:30px auto 62px}.section-card{border-radius:19px;min-height:235px;padding:27px;background:var(--paper);border:1px solid var(--border);box-shadow:var(--shadow);text-align:right;transition:transform .2s,border .2s}.section-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#c9b797}.section-card.active{border:2px solid #bc965c;padding:26px}.section-icon{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:15px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#f3e9d8;font-size:25px;margin-bottom:17px}.section-card:nth-child(2) .section-icon{background:#e5ede6}.section-card:nth-child(3) .section-icon{background:#f5e4df}.section-card h3{font-size:22px;margin:0 0 5px;font-weight:750}.section-card p{margin:0;color:#777d73;font-size:14px;max-width:270px}.section-arrow{float:left;display:inline-block;color:var(--gold);font-size:20px;font-weight:bold;margin-top:11px}
    .collection{padding:0 0 105px;min-height:430px}.collection-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border);padding-bottom:20px}.collection-head h2{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;font-weight:500;font-size:35px;margin:0}.collection-head p{color:var(--muted);margin:4px 0 0}.collection-actions{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap}.entries{margin-top:25px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:20px}.entry{background:#fffdf8;border:1px solid #e7dfd1;border-radius:17px;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 8px 25px rgba(37,43,35,.045);min-width:0}.entry .photo{height:200px;background:#eee8dc;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;color:#9c9e94;font-size:62px}.entry .photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.entry-body{padding:23px}.entry-category{color:#9a784d;text-transform:uppercase;font-size:11px;letter-spacing:.1em;font-weight:bold}.entry h3{font-size:21px;line-height:1.45;margin:5px 0 8px}.entry p{font-size:14px;color:#6a756c;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.entry-sub{color:#a07857;font-size:13px;display:block}.entry-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;padding-top:12px;margin-top:12px;border-top:1px solid #eee8de}.mini{border:0;background:transparent;color:#6b776e;padding:5px 6px;font-size:13px;font-weight:bold}.mini:hover{color:#ac584b}.quote-card{padding-top:28px;position:relative}.quote-card:before{content:'”';display:block;font-family:Georgia,serif;line-height:.65;font-size:80px;color:#d2b98e;margin:0 23px}.quote-card blockquote{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;font-size:24px;line-height:1.6;margin:14px 24px 2px;font-weight:500;white-space:pre-wrap;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.quote-card .entry-body{padding-top:8px}.quote-card .entry-sub{margin-top:12px}
    .entry.person-entry .photo{height:325px;background:radial-gradient(ellipse at 55% 52%,#fff8f1 0%,#f1e4d4 70%,#e5d6c4 100%);overflow:hidden;padding:8px 12px 0}
    .entry.person-entry .photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;}
    /* Melin's approved versions share one family-character card; no cropping. */
    .person-entry.malin-card{grid-column:span 1}
    .person-entry.malin-card .photo{height:390px;position:relative;align-items:end;}
    .person-entry.malin-card .photo img{object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom}
    .malin-gallery{padding:12px 13px 5px;background:#fffdf8;border-bottom:1px solid #f0e5d6}
    .malin-gallery h4{font-size:12px;color:#8f6848;letter-spacing:.01em;margin:0 0 9px;font-weight:700}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-thumbs{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,minmax(0,1fr));gap:6px;direction:rtl}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice{min-width:0;padding:5px 3px 4px;border-radius:9px;border:2px solid transparent;background:#f5eee4;cursor:pointer;transition:transform .14s,border-color .14s;color:var(--ink);font-family:inherit;}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice[aria-pressed="true"]{border-color:#b47884;background:#fae6eb}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice:focus-visible{outline:3px solid #9a536c;outline-offset:1px}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice img{width:100%;height:68px;object-fit:contain;object-position:center bottom;display:block}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-choice .label{font-size:10px;line-height:1.35;min-height:27px;display:block;overflow-wrap:normal}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-caption{font-size:12px;color:#87695e;text-align:center;margin:10px 0 2px;}
    .malin-gallery .gallery-caption strong{font-weight:700}
    .empty{grid-column:1/-1;background:#fffcf4;border:1px dashed #d5c7b2;border-radius:20px;text-align:center;padding:55px 25px}.empty-icon{font-size:48px}.empty h3{margin:6px auto 8px;font-size:24px}.empty p{max-width:480px;margin:auto auto 22px;color:#7d8278}.empty .btn{margin:auto}.footer{background:#eae7dd;border-top:1px solid #ddd8ce;padding:35px 0;text-align:center;color:#6d776d;font-size:14px}.footer span{font-family:Georgia,serif;color:#a97d48;font-size:22px;vertical-align:middle;margin:0 8px}
    dialog{width:min(95vw,590px);max-height:92vh;overflow-y:auto;border:none;border-radius:20px;padding:0;background:#fffdf8;box-shadow:0 30px 100px rgba(0,0,0,.3);color:var(--ink)}dialog::backdrop{background:rgba(15,28,20,.67);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}.modal-header{padding:25px 28px 16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;border-bottom:1px solid var(--border)}.modal-header h2{margin:0;font-size:25px}.iconbtn{border:0;background:transparent;color:#758077;font-size:29px;width:35px;height:35px;line-height:1}form{padding:25px 28px 30px}.form-group{margin-bottom:17px}.form-group label{display:block;font-weight:700;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:6px}.form-group input,.form-group textarea{width:100%;border:1px solid #cfd5cb;border-radius:10px;background:#fff;padding:11px 13px;color:var(--ink);outline:none}.form-group input:focus,.form-group textarea:focus{border-color:var(--gold);box-shadow:0 0 0 3px #e6d6bc55}.form-group textarea{min-height:104px;resize:vertical}.form-hint{font-size:12px;color:#869086;display:block;margin-top:4px}.preview{width:100%;max-height:170px;object-fit:contain;display:none;border-radius:10px;border:1px solid var(--border);background:#f0ece1;margin-top:9px}.form-buttons{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:9px;margin-top:25px}.toast{position:fixed;bottom:24px;left:24px;z-index:40;background:#25382e;color:white;border-radius:12px;padding:12px 20px;box-shadow:0 10px 30px #0003;opacity:0;pointer-events:none;transition:opacity .25s}.toast.show{opacity:1}.sr-only{position:absolute;width:1px;height:1px;padding:0;margin:-1px;overflow:hidden;clip:rect(0,0,0,0);white-space:nowrap;border:0}
    @media(max-width:900px){.hero-inner{min-height:400px}.hero-art{width:270px;transform:scale(.8);transform-origin:center}.sections,.entries{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.section-card:last-child{grid-column:1/-1;min-height:180px}}@media(max-width:670px){.shell{padding:0 17px}.topbar{height:71px}.brand-name{font-size:17px}.brand-sub{font-size:9px}.header-actions .textbtn{font-size:12px;padding:6px}.hero{border-radius:0 0 22px 22px}.hero-inner{padding-top:56px;padding-bottom:45px;display:block;min-height:auto}.hero h1{font-size:clamp(37px,9vw,51px)}.hero p{font-size:16px}.hero-art{display:none}.intro{margin-top:42px;display:block}.intro h2{font-size:30px}.stats{display:block;margin-top:10px}.sections,.entries{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:12px}.sections{margin-top:22px;margin-bottom:48px}.section-card,.section-card:last-child{grid-column:auto;min-height:175px;padding:19px 22px}.section-card.active{padding:18px 21px}.section-icon{float:left;margin:0 0 0 5px;width:43px;height:43px}.section-card h3{font-size:21px}.section-card p{font-size:13px}.section-arrow{float:none;display:block;margin-top:9px}.collection-head{align-items:start;flex-direction:column}.collection-head h2{font-size:30px}.entry .photo{height:220px}.footer{font-size:12px}dialog{max-height:95vh}.modal-header,form{padding-right:20px;padding-left:20px}}
    @media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){*{scroll-behavior:auto!important;transition:none!important}}

    /* Storybook: ארבעת הפאנלים המאושרים של מלין וסבתא שולי */
    #braidsStory[hidden]{display:none!important}
    .braids-story{margin:27px 0 34px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#fffaf1,#f9ede3 60%,#f6e6e6);border:1px solid #e9d7c2;border-radius:23px;padding:clamp(16px,3vw,33px);box-shadow:0 12px 34px rgba(83,56,39,.08)}
    .braids-story-header{text-align:center;max-width:700px;margin:0 auto 23px}
    .braids-story-eyebrow{letter-spacing:.07em;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;color:#a16b67}
    .braids-story h3{font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;font-size:clamp(27px,4vw,40px);font-weight:500;line-height:1.3;color:#44392e;margin:8px 0}
    .braids-story-header p{margin:7px 0 0;color:#786e64;font-size:15px}
    .braids-story-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:18px;direction:rtl}
    .braids-panel{margin:0;min-width:0;background:#fffdf9;border:1px solid #e4d8cd;box-shadow:0 8px 24px rgba(54,38,29,.08);border-radius:13px;overflow:hidden}
    .braids-panel button{width:100%;padding:0;border:0;background:transparent;display:block;cursor:zoom-in}
    .braids-panel img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:contain;background:#fff4ec}
    .braids-panel button:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #d17e99;outline-offset:-5px}
    .braids-panel figcaption{padding:12px 16px 14px;display:flex;justify-content:flex-start;align-items:baseline;gap:9px;color:#483d39}
    .braids-panel figcaption .num{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-shrink:0;border-radius:50%;width:24px;height:24px;background:#f5e3e5;color:#98556a;font-size:12px;font-weight:bold}
    .braids-panel figcaption strong{font-size:15px}
    .braids-story-hint{text-align:center;color:#8b7c72;margin:16px 0 0;font-size:12px}
    #braidsViewer{width:min(96vw,1150px);max-width:none;max-height:96vh;padding:0;background:#1c2021;color:white;border:1px solid #43403e;border-radius:14px;overflow:auto}
    #braidsViewer::backdrop{background:rgba(15,12,15,.86)}
    .braids-viewer-bar{padding:9px 13px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;justify-content:space-between;direction:rtl}
    #braidsViewerTitle{font-weight:700;color:#fff5e9;font-size:14px}
    .braids-viewer-close{border:1px solid #79716d;background:#303235;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;min-width:40px;height:38px}
    #braidsViewerImage{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;max-height:calc(96vh - 105px);object-fit:contain;margin:auto}
    .braids-viewer-controls{display:flex;justify-content:center;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:7px 15px 12px;direction:rtl}
    .braids-viewer-controls button{border:1px solid #79716d;background:#303235;color:#fff;border-radius:9px;padding:6px 15px}
    #braidsViewerCounter{font-size:13px;color:#e5d9cb}
    @media(max-width:670px){.braids-story{padding:14px;margin:18px 0 25px}.braids-story-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:14px}.braids-story h3{font-size:29px}.braids-panel figcaption{padding:10px 12px}.braids-panel figcaption strong{font-size:14px}}

    /* Custom story routing: inside Melin's character card, not in general memories. */
    .entries .person-entry.malin-card{grid-column:span 2}
    .malin-story-mount{padding:0 19px 20px}
    .malin-story-mount .braids-story{margin:0;box-shadow:none;border-radius:16px}
    .malin-story-mount .braids-story-grid{gap:12px}
    .malin-story-mount .braids-story-header{margin-bottom:14px}
    .malin-story-mount .braids-story h3{font-size:clamp(25px,3.1vw,36px)}
    .featured-braid-quote{max-width:850px;margin:26px auto 25px;padding:clamp(15px,3.2vw,30px);border-radius:24px;border:1px solid #e8d5c7;background:linear-gradient(150deg,#fff9ef,#f8e8e9);box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(63,40,31,.08);text-align:center}
    .featured-braid-quote[hidden]{display:none!important}
    .featured-braid-quote-heading h3{font-size:clamp(26px,4.7vw,45px);font-family:Georgia,'Noto Serif Hebrew',serif;color:#6c3b49;margin:5px 0;line-height:1.3}
    .featured-braid-quote-heading p{font-size:15px;color:#73635e;margin:0 0 18px}
    .featured-braid-photo{border:0;padding:0;background:#fffaf5;border-radius:14px;overflow:hidden;width:100%;box-shadow:0 5px 18px rgba(53,35,36,.14);cursor:zoom-in;display:block}
    .featured-braid-photo img{display:block;width:100%;height:auto;aspect-ratio:3/2;object-fit:contain}
    .featured-braid-photo:focus-visible{outline:4px solid #bd7289;outline-offset:3px}
    .featured-braid-actions{display:flex;gap:15px;align-items:center;justify-content:center;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:16px}
    .featured-braid-actions span{color:#7b6b68;font-size:12px}
    @media(max-width:920px){.entries .person-entry.malin-card{grid-column:1/-1}}
    @media(max-width:670px){.malin-story-mount{padding:0 11px 14px}.featured-braid-quote{margin:19px 0 23px}.featured-braid-quote-heading p{font-size:13px}}
  </style>
</head>
<body>
  <header><div class="shell topbar"><a href="#start" class="brand" aria-label="הסיפור של סבתא שולי — לעמוד הראשי"><span class="brand-mark">ש</span><span class="brand-name">סבתא שולי <small class="brand-sub">האלבום המשפחתי שלנו</small></span></a><div class="header-actions"><button type="button" id="backupBtn" class="textbtn" title="שמירת כל הסיפורים והתמונות בקובץ">↓ גיבוי</button><button type="button" id="restoreBtn" class="textbtn" title="טעינת גיבוי קודם">↑ שחזור</button><input type="file" id="backupFile" accept="application/json,.json" hidden /></div></div></header>
  <main id="start"><div class="hero"><div class="shell hero-inner"><div class="hero-copy"><div class="eyebrow">אלבום משפחתי מיוחד</div><h1>יש סיפורים<br>ש<em>נשארים איתנו.</em></h1><p>האנשים שעשו את הדרך, הרגעים שראוי לשמור, והמשפטים של סבתא שולי שאי אפשר לשכוח.</p><div class="hero-cta"><button type="button" class="btn primary" id="heroExplore">לפתוח את האלבום <span aria-hidden="true">←</span></button><button type="button" class="btn ghost" id="heroAdd">להוסיף זיכרון +</button></div></div><div class="hero-art" aria-hidden="true"><div class="paper back"><div class="paper-image"></div></div><div class="paper front"><div class="paper-image"></div></div><div class="sprig">❧</div></div></div></div>
  <section class="shell" id="album"><div class="intro"><div><span class="kicker">שלושה שערים לזיכרונות</span><h2>הסיפור שלנו, בשלושה פרקים</h2><p>לוחצים על מדור, מוסיפים תמונה או סיפור, וממשיכים לבנות את האלבום ביחד.</p></div><div class="stats" id="stats">0 זיכרונות באלבום</div></div>
  <nav class="sections" aria-label="מדורי האלבום"><button type="button" class="section-card active" data-tab="people" aria-pressed="true"><div class="section-icon" aria-hidden="true">♟</div><h3>דמויות</h3><p>האנשים שליוו את סבתא, בני המשפחה והדמויות שאי אפשר לשכוח.</p><span class="section-arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span></button><button type="button" class="section-card" data-tab="memories" aria-pressed="false"><div class="section-icon" aria-hidden="true">▧</div><h3>רגעים מהעבר</h3><p>תמונות, מקומות, חוויות וסיפורים שיש להם מקום בלב.</p><span class="section-arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span></button><button type="button" class="section-card" data-tab="quotes" aria-pressed="false"><div class="section-icon" aria-hidden="true">❞</div><h3>משפטי מחץ</h3><p>האמירות המצחיקות, החכמות והבלתי נשכחות של המשפחה.</p><span class="section-arrow" aria-hidden="true">←</span></button></nav></section>
